comparison: Fresh random 411M founder versus the completed 105M 16384-slot founder at the same four curriculum endpoints. Recheck every 105M assessment through the new executable before starting 411M. Preserve all six per-book losses and four raw generations at each stage. Match source, replay and speech exposure and replay payloads; do not infer matched wall time or FLOPs.
policy_rationale: The completed 16384-slot replay comparison improved final development scores for both tested sizes. Early core-rate reductions produced mixed seed results, so retain the ordinary rate as an explicit baseline rather than extrapolating an unverified width rule. Saving every 8192 observations changes persistence frequency, not the learning policy.
limits: One seed, one untuned learning rate and a selected prose curriculum. The 411M capacity benchmark establishes only short-workload feasibility. New checkpoints require actual full-size save/load, evaluation and resume preflight. Full learning is not proof of useful QA, general intelligence, biological age, or reproductive fitness. No test books are scored and no founder is automatically admitted as a teacher or parent.
